questions.analysis:
$$m \omega^{2} R = G M_{c} m (1 + \eta) / R^{2} \Longrightarrow \omega = \sqrt{\frac{G M_{c}(1 + \eta)}{R^{4}}} \tag{1}$$

因此:

$$\theta_{B}=\theta_{A}\frac{\omega_{B}}{\omega_{A}} \tag{2}$$

(2)①根据余弦定理:

$$\theta = \theta_{B} - \theta_{A} = 2 \pi N \left[ \sqrt{\frac{1 + \eta_{B}}{1 + \eta_{A}}} - 1 \right] \approx \pi N (\eta_{B} - \eta_{A}) \tag{3}$$

注意到:

$$\varphi=-\frac{GM_{c}}{\sqrt{R^{2}+\delta^{2}+2R\delta\cos\theta}} \tag{4}$$

$$\frac{1}{\sqrt{1 + x}} \approx 1 - \frac{1}{2}x + \frac{3}{8}x^{2}$$

因此:

$$\varphi \approx - \frac{GM_{c}}{R}\left( 1 - \frac{\delta}{R}\cos\theta + \frac{3\cos^{2}\theta - 1}{2}\frac{\delta^{2}}{R^{2}} \right)$$

②如果忽略卫星的摆动，并忽略检测物位移，根据质心运动定理:

$$(m_{T} + m_{0})\omega^{2}R = \frac{GM_{c}}{R^{2}}[m_{T}(1 + \eta_{T}) + m_{0}(1 + \eta_{0})] \tag{6}$$

$\varphi = \omega t$ 为卫星取向和卫星—地球中心连线的夹角，此时在相对卫星质心静止的参考系中可知:

$$m_{T} \ddot{x} = \left( \frac{G M_{c} m_{T}}{R^{2}} (1 + \eta_{T}) - m_{T} \omega^{2} R \right) \cos\varphi \tag{7}$$

因此得到:

$$\ddot{x} = \frac{GM_{e}\cos\omega t}{R^{2}}\frac{m_{0}(\eta_{T} - \eta_{0})}{m_{T} + m_{0}} \tag{8}$$

显然这个方程对应一个简谐振荡的特解，而其振幅为:

$$A = R \times \frac{GM_{c}}{\omega^{2}R^{3}}\frac{m_{0}|\eta_{T} - \eta_{0}|}{m_{T} + m_{0}} \approx \frac{m_{0}|\eta_{T} - \eta_{0}|}{m_{T} + m_{0}}R \tag{9}$$

(3)①为了计算方便，不妨以系统质心为原点，沿着卫星轴线方向引入n轴，沿垂直于其方向引入p轴，最后沿着垂直于图示方向引入z轴。此时根据定义可以给出检测物的势能:

$$x_{T}=\frac{m_{0}x}{m_{0}+m_{T}} \tag{10}$$

取向和径向夹角余弦:

$$\varphi_{T}=-\frac{G M_{c} m_{T}(1+\eta_{T})}{R+\delta}\left[1-\frac{\sin(\phi-\theta)}{R+\delta}\frac{m_{0}x}{m_{0}+m_{T}}+\frac{3\sin^{2}(\phi-\theta)-1}{2}\left(\frac{m_{0}}{m_{0}+m_{T}}\frac{x}{R+\delta}\right)^{2}\right] \tag{12}$$

对于卫星的势能，其质心相对系统质心偏移量:

$$x_{00} = \frac{-m_T x}{m_0 + m_T} \tag{13}$$

引入坐标描述各个质元的位置:

$$\begin{aligned}x_{m} = x_{m0} + \frac{m_{T}}{m_{0} + m_{T}} \frac{x}{R + \delta} \tag{14} \\ x_{p} = x_{p0} \tag{15}\end{aligned}$$

此时系统的总势能为:

$$\begin{aligned}\varphi_{01} = - \frac{G M_{c}(1 + \eta_{T})}{R + \delta} \int \rho d V \left\{ 1 - \frac{\sin(\phi - \theta)}{R + \delta} \left( x_{m0} + \frac{m_{T}}{m_{0} + m_{T}} \frac{x}{R + \delta} \right) \right. \\ \left. - \frac{1}{2(R + \delta)^{2}} \left( 2 r_{//}^{2} - r_{\perp}^{2} \right) + \frac{z^{2}}{2(R + \delta)^{2}} \right\} \tag{16}\end{aligned}$$

其中 $r_{//}$ 代表平行于位矢的坐标分量，结果为:

$$\begin{aligned} &r_{//} = x_m \sin\left( \phi - \theta \right) + x_p \cos\left( \phi - \theta \right) \tag{17} \\ &r_{\perp} = x_m \cos\left( \phi - \theta \right) - x_p \sin\left( \phi - \theta \right) \tag{18}\end{aligned}$$

此时有:

$$2 r_{//}^{2} - r_{\perp}^{2} = ( 3 \sin^{2} (\phi - \theta) - 1 ) x_{n}^{2} + ( 3 \cos^{2} (\phi - \theta) - 1 ) x_{p}^{2} + 2 x_{m} x_{p} \sin (\phi - \theta) \cos (\phi - \theta) \tag{19}$$

为了计算积分，注意到:

$$\begin{aligned}\int \rho x_{m,p0}dV = \int \rho z dV = 0 \tag{20} \\ \int \rho z^{2}dV = \int \rho x_{p0}^{2}dV = \frac{I_{m}}{2} \tag{21} \\ \int \rho x_{m0}^{2}dV = I_{p} - \frac{I_{m}}{2} \tag{22}\end{aligned}$$

因此:

$$\begin{aligned}\int \rho d V \frac{\sin \left( \phi - \theta \right)}{R + \delta} \left( x_{m 0} + \frac{m_{T}}{m_{0} + m_{T}} \frac{r}{R + \delta} \right) &= \frac{m_{T}}{m_{0} + m_{T}} \frac{m_{0} x \sin \left( \phi - \theta \right)}{\left( R + \delta \right)^{2}} \tag{23} \\ \int \rho d V \left( 2 r_{//}^{2} - r_{\perp}^{2} \right) &= \left( 3 \sin^{2} \left( \phi - \theta \right) - 1 \right) \left[ m_{0} \left( \frac{m_{T}}{m_{0} + m_{T}} \frac{x}{R + \delta} \right)^{2} + I_{p} - \frac{I_{m}}{2} \right] \\ &+ \left( 3 \cos^{2} \left( \phi - \theta \right) - 1 \right) \left( I_{p} - \frac{I_{m}}{2} \right) \tag{24}\end{aligned}$$

代入所有结果，可以求出:

$$\begin{aligned}V = \varphi_{I} + & \varphi_{o} \\= - \frac{GM_{c}m_{T}(1 + \eta_{I})}{R + \delta}\left[1 - \frac{\sin\left(\phi - \theta\right)}{R + \delta}\frac{m_{0}x}{m_{0} + m_{T}} + \frac{3\sin^{2}\left(\phi - \theta\right) - 1}{2}\left(\frac{m_{0}}{m_{0} + m_{T}}\frac{x}{R + \delta}\right)^{2}\right] \\- \frac{GM_{e}(1 + \eta_{T})}{R + \delta}\left[m_{0} + \frac{\mu x\sin\left(\phi - \theta\right)}{R + \delta} + \left(\frac{x}{R + \delta}\right)^{2}\left(\frac{m_{0}}{m_{0} + m_{T}}\right)^{2}\sin^{2}\left(\phi - \theta\right)\right. \\\left. + \frac{3\cos^{2}\left(\phi - \theta\right)}{2(R + \delta)^{2}}(I_{\nu} - I_{\rho}) + \frac{4I_{p} - 3I_{m}}{4(R + \delta)^{2}} \tag{25}\right.\end{aligned}$$

其中 $\mu = m_{T} m_{0} / ( m_{T} + m_{0} )$ 是约化质量，注意到 $\delta$ 应当被精确至二阶小量，而且包含引力修正系数的部分只需要精确至一阶，而且可同项结合得到，这时可以得到势能的近似结果:

$$\begin{aligned}V{\approx}-\frac{GM_{e}m_{T}(1+\eta_{T})}{R}\left(1-\frac{\delta}{R}+\frac{\delta^{2}}{R^{2}}\right)-\frac{GM_{e}m_{0}(1+\eta_{0})}{R}\left(1-\frac{\delta}{R}+\frac{\delta^{2}}{R^{2}}\right) \\+\frac{GM_{e}\mu(\eta_{T}-\eta_{0})\sin\left(\phi-\theta\right)x}{\left(R+\delta\right)^{3}}-\frac{GM_{e}\mu x^{2}}{2\left(R+\delta\right)^{3}}[3\sin^{2}\left(\phi-\theta\right)-1]+\frac{3GM_{e}}{2R^{3}}\left(I_{p}-I_{m}\right)\cos^{2}\left(\phi-\theta\right) \tag{26}\end{aligned}$$

此处舍去了不会变化的常数，进一步近似得到:

$$\begin{aligned}V \approx - \frac{GM_{\epsilon}(m_{0} + m_{T})}{R}\left( - \frac{\delta}{R} + \frac{\delta^{2}}{R^{2}} \right) - \frac{GM_{\epsilon}\mu x^{2}}{2R^{3}}\left[ 3\sin^{2}(\phi - \theta) - 1 \right] \\+ \frac{3GM_{\epsilon}}{2R^{3}}\left( I_{p} - I_{m} \right)\cos^{2}(\phi - \theta) + \frac{GM_{\epsilon}\mu(\eta_{T} - \eta_{0})\sin(\phi - \theta)x}{R^{3}} \tag{27}\end{aligned}$$

这里不考虑 $\delta$ 项缘故是该二阶小量远远不及式子第一项的二阶小量大。

②根据柯尼希定理，系统动能等于质心动能加上相对质心动能:

$$T = \frac{1}{2}(m_{0} + m_{T})[\dot{\delta}^{2} + (R + \delta)^{2}\dot{\phi}^{2}] + \frac{1}{2}I_{p}\dot{\theta}^{2} + \frac{1}{2}\mu\dot{x}^{2}$$

(3)系统的拉格朗日量为:

$$L = T - V$$

此时考察x变量横向受力:

$$\mu \ddot{x} = - \frac{\partial V}{\partial x} = \frac{G M_{e} \mu x}{R^{4}} \left[ 3 \sin^{2} (\phi - \theta) - 1 \right] - \frac{G M_{e} \mu (\eta_{T} - \eta_{0}) \sin (\phi - \theta)}{R^{4}} \tag{29}$$

与此同时其他参数满足的方程为:

a、$\delta$ 参数:

$$\left( m_{0} + m_{T} \right) \ddot{\delta} = - \frac{\partial V}{\partial \delta} \approx \left( m_{0} + m_{T} \right) \left( R + \delta \right) \dot{\phi}^{2} - \frac{G M_{r} \left( m_{0} + m_{T} \right)}{R^{2}} + \frac{2 G M_{r} \left( m_{0} + m_{T} \right) \delta}{R^{3}} \tag{30}$$

b、$\phi$ 参数的角动量定理:

$$\begin{aligned}\frac{d}{dt}[(m_{0}+m_{T})(R+\delta)^{2}\dot{\phi}] \approx (m_{0}+m_{T})R(R\ddot{\phi}+2\dot{\delta}\dot{\phi})=&-\frac{\partial V}{\partial \phi}\approx\frac{3GM_{r}}{R^{3}}(I_{\rho}-I_{m})\sin\left(\phi-\theta\right)\cos\left(\phi-\theta\right) \tag{31}\end{aligned}$$

c、$\theta$ 参数角动量定理:

$$I_{p} \ddot{\theta} = - \frac{\partial V}{\partial \theta} \approx - \frac{3 G M_{c}}{R^{3}} ( I_{p} - I_{m} ) \cos ( \phi - \theta ) \sin ( \phi - \theta ) \tag{32}$$

这里舍去了所有可以忽略的小量，进而在平动模式下可以发现零级解:

$$\delta = 0 , \theta = 0 , \dot{\phi} = \sqrt{\frac{G M_{c}}{R^{3}}} \tag{33}$$

由于(29)式子的角度一阶部分可以忽略，因此x满足方程:

$$\ddot{x} = \frac{G M_{e} x}{R^{3}} \left[ 3 \sin^{2} \sqrt{\frac{G M_{r}}{R^{3}}} t - 1 \right] - \frac{G M_{\epsilon} \mu (\eta_{T} - \eta_{0}) \sin \sqrt{\frac{G M_{r}}{R^{3}}} t}{R^{2}} \tag{34}$$

考虑长时间平均，用最简单的 $\overline{fg} = \overline{f} \times \overline{g}$ 估计结果:

$$\ddot{x} = \frac{GM_c \bar{x}}{R^3} \times \left( \frac{3}{2} - 1 \right) = \frac{GM_c}{2R^3} \bar{x} \tag{35}$$

这是一个非稳定线性方程，可见检测物的运动是不稳定的。

④a、在同步模式下，即卫星指向时刻垂直地球时，可以得到零级解:

$$\dot{\theta}_{0} = \dot{\phi}_{0} = \omega_{0} = \sqrt{\frac{G M_{e}}{R^{3}}} \tag{36}$$

引入它们的微扰量 $\Delta\phi$、$\Delta\theta$，可以得到③所述的方程组的近似结果:

$$\begin{array}{c} \ddot{x} = - \omega_{0}^{2} x - \frac{G M_{e} \mu (\eta_{T} - \eta_{0})}{R^{2}} (\phi - \theta) \tag{37} \\ \ddot{\delta} = 3 \omega_{0}^{2} \delta + 2 \omega_{0} R \Delta\dot{\phi} \tag{38} \end{array}$$

$$\Delta\ddot{\theta} = - \frac{3 \omega_{0}^{2} (I_{p} - I_{m})}{I_{p}} (\Delta\phi - \Delta\theta) \tag{39}$$

$$\Delta\ddot{\phi} = - 2 \omega_{0} \frac{\dot{\delta}}{R} + \frac{3 \omega_{0}^{2} (I_{p} - I_{m})}{(m_{0} + m_{T}) R^{2}} (\Delta\phi - \Delta\theta) \tag{40}$$

b、现在考虑(39)(40)式子作差，消去角度差函数，并完成积分:

$$I_{p} \Delta\dot{\theta} + (m_{0} + m_{T}) R^{2} \big( \Delta\dot{\phi} + 2 \omega_{0} \delta / R \big) = 0 \tag{41}$$

此处得到该结果为零的重要原因是若上式不等于零，则微扰项存在一个恒定的增长速率，这是不合法的。注意到 $( m_{0} + m_{T} ) R^{2} \gg I_{p}$，所以可近似认为:

$$\Delta\dot{\phi} \approx - 2 \omega_{0} \delta / R \tag{42}$$

此时可以得到(38)式的计算结果:

$$\ddot{\delta} = - \omega_{0}^{2} \delta \tag{43}$$

此时根据 $I_{p} > I_{m}$ 的事实，可见 $\Delta\theta$ 的方程等效于一个简谐驱动项作用于一个线性排斥力所作用的系统中，此时对应的运动必然是不稳定的。



（见上）

二、（45分）参考解答: (40刀ノ少与肝石:

(1)①因为如果流速的环路积分非零，就等价于有一个旋转的涡流，这势必会引起粘滞耗散，最终趋于静止（2分）

②i、显然它的物理意义是液滴的平动，对振动没有贡献。——(2分）

ii、对于①的说法，考察正方体的xy面，此时:
questions.analysis:
$$
\Delta_{xy} = (\gamma_y - \gamma_r)a \tag{1}
$$

考察xz面，此时:

$$
\varDelta _ { x : } = \big ( 0 - \gamma _ { y } \big ) a \tag{2}
$$

考察yz面:

$$
\Delta_{y:} = (\gamma_{\varepsilon} - 0)a\tag{3}
$$

考虑到环量为零:

$$
\gamma_{x}=\gamma_{y}=0\tag{4}
$$

更进一步地，考虑到给定dt时间内的流体流入体积:

$$
d Q = \beta _ { x } ( a + x ) a ^ { 2 } - \beta _ { x } z a ^ { 2 } + \beta _ { y } ( a + y ) a ^ { 2 } - \beta _ { y } y a ^ { 2 } + \alpha ( z + a ) a ^ { 2 } - \alpha z a ^ { 2 } = a ^ { 3 } ( \beta _ { x } + \beta _ { y } + \alpha ) \tag{5}
$$

考虑到质量守恒:

$$
d Q = 0 \Longrightarrow \beta _ { x } + \beta _ { y } + \alpha = 0 \tag{6}
$$

(2)①由于(1)已经给出了:

$$
\frac { d } { d t } \big ( \beta _ { x } + \beta _ { y } + \alpha \big ) = 0 \tag{7}
$$

此时直接积分可以得到各个点的位移，此时可以得到边界面的位移量为:

$$
\vec { \delta } = \alpha z _ { 0 } \hat { z } + \beta _ { x } x _ { 0 } \hat { x } + \beta _ { y } y _ { 0 } \hat { y } \tag{8}
$$

此时体积增量一定可以通过径向位移量——表面积的积分给出:

$$
\varDelta V = \int \vec{\delta} \cdot \vec{r}/r dS = \int dS \frac{\alpha z_{0}^{2} + \beta_{x}x_{0}^{2} + \beta_{y}y_{0}^{2}}{r^{2}} \tag{9}
$$

这里在一级近似下，只需要考虑球面上的积分，显然有:

$$
\int d S \frac { z _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } } { r ^ { 2 } } = \int d S \frac { x _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } } { r ^ { 2 } } = \int d S \frac { y _ { 0 } ^ { 2 } } { r ^ { 2 } } \tag{10}
$$

因此:

$$
\Delta V \propto ( \alpha + \beta _ { r } + \beta _ { y } ) \tag{11}
$$

由此可见:

$$
\beta _ { x } + \beta _ { y } + \alpha = 0 \tag{12}
$$

②考虑到流速分布给定后，可以求出:

$$
E _ { k } = \frac { 1 } { 2 } \int \rho v ^ { 2 } d V = \frac { 1 } { 2 } \int \rho [ \dot { \alpha } ^ { 2 } z ^ { 2 } + \dot { \beta } _ { x } ^ { 2 } x ^ { 2 } + \dot { \beta } _ { y } ^ { 2 } y ^ { 2 } ] d V \tag{13}
$$

在球体中考虑积分:

$$
\int z ^ { 2 } d V = 2 \pi \int _ { 0 } ^ { \pi } \int _ { 0 } ^ { R } r ^ { 2 } \cos ^ { 2 } \theta \times r ^ { 2 } d r \times \sin \theta d \theta = \frac { 2 \pi } { 5 } R ^ { 5 } \times \frac { 2 } { 3 } = \frac { 4 \pi R ^ { 5 } } { 1 5 } \tag{14}
$$

考虑到对称性，每个方向的坐标平方的球体积分相同:

$$
E_{k} = \frac{2\pi\rho R^{5}}{15}\left( \dot{\alpha}^{2} + \dot{\beta}_{x}^{2} + \dot{\beta}_{y}^{2} \right) = \frac{2\pi\rho R^{5}}{15}\left[ \dot{\alpha}^{2} + \dot{\beta}_{x}^{2} + \dot{\alpha} + \dot{\beta}_{r} \right] \tag{15}
$$

③为了计算表面能，考虑到一个事实，流动偏移使得:

$$
z _ { 0 } \rightarrow { \bigl ( } 1 + \alpha { \bigr ) } z _ { 0 } ; x _ { 0 } \rightarrow { \bigl ( } 1 + \beta _ { x } { \bigr ) } x _ { 0 } ; y _ { 0 } \rightarrow { \bigl ( } 1 + \beta _ { y } { \bigr ) } y _ { 0 } \tag{16}
$$

因此线性流动模式是一个线性映射，将球体拉伸为一个椭球体。此时表面方程为:

$$
\frac{z^{2}}{\left ( 1 + \alpha  \right ) ^{2} } + \frac{x^{2}}{\left ( 1 + \beta _{r} \right ) ^{2} } + \frac{y^{2}}{\left ( 1 + \beta _{y} \right ) ^{2} } = R^{2} \tag{17}
$$

如果直接计算面积微扰固然是非常复杂的，对此应该采用独立振动的思路。如果振动模式可以分解为多个独立模式，那么每个模式的势能，或者说表面能一定是可以叠加的。而显然该模式一定是轴对称流动。接下来将流速场分解为多个轴对称模式的结果，轴对称模式的特点是:

$$
\vec { v } = \dot { \alpha }  { \boldsymbol { \mathsf { { z } } } } \hat {  { \mathsf { { z } } } } - \frac { 1 } { 2 } \dot { \alpha } ( x \hat { x } + y \hat { y } ) \tag{18}
$$

此时轴可以换成其他轴，这里我们预期两个模式:

②单独研究

③单独

$$
\ddot { v } = \left[ \dot { \alpha } _ { 1 } \dot { z } \ddot { z } - \frac { 1 } { 2 } \dot { \alpha } _ { 1 } ( x \dot { x } + y \ddot { y } ) \right] + \left[ \dot { \alpha } _ { 2 } x \dot { x } - \frac { 1 } { 2 } \dot { \alpha } _ { 2 } ( y \ddot { y } + z \ddot { z } ) \right] , \dot { \alpha } _ { 1 } - \frac { 1 } { 2 } \dot { \alpha } _ { 2 } = \dot { \alpha } , \dot { \beta } _ { x } = \dot { \alpha } _ { 2 } - \frac { 1 } { 2 } \dot { \alpha } _ { 1 } \tag{19}
$$

这里得到:

$$
\dot { \alpha } _ { 1 } - \frac { 1 } { 4 } \dot { \alpha } _ { 1 } = \dot { \alpha } + \frac { 1 } { 2 } \dot { \beta } _ { r } , \dot { \alpha } _ { 1 } = \frac { 4 } { 3 } \left( \dot { \alpha } + \frac { 1 } { 2 } \dot { \beta } _ { r } \right) . \dot { \alpha } _ { 2 } = \frac { 4 } { 3 } \left( \dot { \beta } _ { t } + \frac { 1 } { 2 } \dot { \alpha } \right) \tag{20}
$$

只要计算两种模式 $\hat { \Omega } _ { 1 } , \Omega _ { 2 }$ 独立引起的能量，然后作(27)的替代叠加即可。此时对于给定模式α，表面积为:

$$
S = \int 2 \pi r ( z ) \sqrt { 1 + \left( \frac { d r } { d z } \right) ^ { 2 } } d z , r = \left( 1 - \frac { 1 } { 2 } \alpha \right) \sqrt { R ^ { 2 } - \frac { z ^ { 2 } } { ( 1 + \alpha ) ^ { 2 } } } , \frac { d r } { d z } = \left( 1 - \frac { 1 } { 2 } \alpha \right) \frac { - \cfrac { z } { \left( 1 + \alpha \right) ^ { 2 } } } { \sqrt { R ^ { 2 } - \cfrac { z ^ { 2 } } { \left( 1 + \alpha \right) ^ { 2 } } } } \tag{21}
$$

\omega = C r ^ { \ddag } + \frac { C ^ { \prime } } { r } + C ^ { \prime \prime } \# ( 3 4 )
$$

其中C是方程的齐次解，根据边界条件可以断定 $C^{'} = 0$ ，所以:

$$
24\pi Cr^{3}=\frac{8NV_{0}c^{2}}{\eta k_{D}TR}r^{3}\Longrightarrow C=\frac{NV_{0}c^{2}}{3\pi\eta k_{B}TR}\#(35)(2)
$$

结合边界流速条件，因此可以得到:

$$
\Omega ( r ) = \frac { N V _ { 0 } e ^ { 2 } } { 3 \pi \eta k _ { D } T R } ( r ^ { 3 } - R ^ { 3 } ) \# ( 3 6 ) ( 2 )
$$
questions.answer:
(1) 不会，因为从对称性出发，正负电荷对称布居于电极两侧，此时系统电偶极矩沿着电极连线方向，在外电场中不会受到力矩。

(2) ① 径向电场 $E_{r} = - \frac{\partial \varphi}{\partial r}$，切向电场 $E_{\theta} = - \frac{1}{r}\frac{\partial \varphi}{\partial \theta}$；柱体内电通量 $d\varPhi = - h r dr d\theta\left[\frac{1}{r}\frac{\partial}{\partial r}\left(r\frac{\partial \varphi}{\partial r}\right) + \frac{1}{r^{2}}\frac{\partial^{2}\varphi}{\partial \theta^{2}}\right]$。② 电荷量 $dQ = - 2eN\sinh\frac{e\varphi}{k_{B}T}hrdrd\theta$，泊松方程为 $\frac{1}{r}\frac{\partial}{\partial r}\left(r\frac{\partial \varphi}{\partial r}\right) + \frac{1}{r^{2}}\frac{\partial^{2}\varphi}{\partial \theta^{2}} = \frac{2eN}{\varepsilon_{r}\varepsilon_{0}}\sinh\frac{e\varphi}{k_{B}T}$，常数 $A = \frac{2eN}{\varepsilon_{r}\varepsilon_{0}}$。

(3) 弱电压条件下 $\sinh\frac{e\varphi}{k_{B}T} \approx \frac{e\varphi}{k_{B}T}$，方程化为 $\frac{1}{r}\frac{\partial}{\partial r}\left(r\frac{\partial \varphi}{\partial r}\right) + \frac{1}{r^{2}}\frac{\partial^{2}\varphi}{\partial \theta^{2}} \approx \frac{2Ne^{2}}{\varepsilon_{r}\varepsilon_{0}k_{B}T}\varphi$。设 $\varphi = \sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{4}{(2n-1)\pi}f_{n}(r)\sin(2n-1)\theta$，得 $f_{n}$ 满足 $\frac{1}{x}\frac{d}{dx}\left(x\frac{df_{n}}{dx}\right) - f_{n} - \frac{(2n-1)^{2}}{x^{2}}f_{n} = 0$。当 $x \gg 1$ 时 $f_{n} \approx \frac{e^{\pm x}}{\sqrt{x}}$，取正指数分支，得 $\varphi = V_{0}\sqrt{\frac{R}{r}}\exp\left(\sqrt{\frac{2Ne^{2}}{\varepsilon_{r}\varepsilon_{0}k_{B}T}}(r-R)\right)f(\theta)$，其中 $f(\theta) = 1\ (0<\theta<\pi)$，$f(\theta) = -1\ (\pi<\theta<0)$。旋转阻力矩 $dM = -\frac{8Ne^{2}}{k_{B}T}r^{2}V_{0}\sqrt{\frac{R}{r}}\exp\left(\sqrt{\frac{2Ne^{2}}{\varepsilon_{r}\varepsilon_{0}k_{B}T}}(r-R)\right)dr$，与粘滞力矩平衡得 $\eta\frac{d^{2}\omega}{dr^{2}} = \frac{4Ne^{2}}{\pi k_{B}T}V_{0}\exp\left(\sqrt{\frac{2Ne^{2}}{\varepsilon_{r}\varepsilon_{0}k_{B}T}}(r-R)\right)$，积分得 $\omega(r) = \frac{2\varepsilon_{r}\varepsilon_{0}V_{0}}{\pi\eta}\left[\exp\left(\sqrt{\frac{2Ne^{2}}{\varepsilon_{r}\varepsilon_{0}k_{B}T}}(r-R)\right) - 1\right]$。

当 $r$ 很小时，方程渐近形式为 $\frac{d}{dx}\left(x\frac{df_{n}}{dx}\right) - \frac{(2n-1)^{2}}{x^{2}}f_{n} = 0$，幂级数解 $f_{n} = Cx^{2n-1}$，得 $\varphi(r,\theta) = \sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{4V_{0}}{(2n-1)\pi}\left(\frac{r}{R}\right)^{2n-1}\sin(2n-1)\theta$。力矩 $dM = -\frac{8NV_{0}e^{2}}{k_{B}TR}r^{3}dr$，平衡方程 $\frac{d}{dr}\left(2\pi r^{2}\frac{d\omega(r)}{dr}\right) = \frac{8NV_{0}e^{2}}{\eta k_{B}TR}r^{3}$，解得 $\omega = Cr^{3} + \frac{C'}{r} + C''$，由边界条件 $C' = 0$，$C = \frac{NV_{0}e^{2}}{3\pi\eta k_{B}TR}$，最终 $\Omega(r) = \frac{NV_{0}e^{2}}{3\pi\eta k_{B}TR}(r^{3} - R^{3})$。

questions.content:
四、（50分）

(1)①设x为环心和球心距离，由于球体本身不带电，此时为了保证球体静电平衡，电极上的电荷必然对此产生感应电荷。考虑到电极细，可视作线电荷分布，设 $Q = C_{0}V$ 其带电量，此时可以求出球体的镜像电荷:
questions.analysis:
$$Q^{'} = - \frac{C_{0}VR_{1}}{\sqrt{x^{2} + R_{1}^{2}}}\tag{1}$$

此时中心存在补充电荷:

$$Q_{c}=-Q^{'}=\frac{C_{0}VR_{1}}{\sqrt{x^{2}+R_{1}^{2}}}\tag{2}$$

此时考虑到电极距离足够远，两种组电荷可以近似构成沿着x方向的电偶极矩:

$$p = - Q \times \frac{R_{1}^{2}}{\sqrt{x^{2} + R_{1}^{2}}} = + \frac{C_{0}VR_{1}^{3}}{x^{2} + R_{1}^{2}}\tag{3}$$

此时考虑到外部电场为:

$$E(x) = \frac{C_{0}V}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}}\frac{x}{\sqrt{x^{2} + R_{2}^{2}}}\tag{4}$$

此时得到电偶极矩受力为:

$$f = p \frac{dE}{dx} = \frac{C_{0}V}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0}} \frac{C_{0}VR_{1}^{3}}{x^{2} + R_{1}^{2}} \left[ \frac{1}{\sqrt{x^{2} + R_{2}^{2}}} - \frac{3}{2} \frac{2x^{2}}{(x^{2}+R_{2}^{2})^{3/2}} \right] = \frac{C_{0}V}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0}} \frac{C_{0}VR_{1}^{3}}{x^{2} + R_{1}^{2}} \frac{R_{2}^{2} - 2x^{2}}{(x^{2}+R_{2}^{2})^{3/2}}\tag{5}$$

因此得到从球体滚来到接触时，外力所做的功:

$$W = \int_{-\infty}^{0} f d x = \frac{(C_0 V)^2 R_1^2}{4 \pi \varepsilon_0} \int_{-\infty}^{0} \frac{1}{x^2 + R_1^2} \frac{R_2^2 - 2 x^2}{(x^{2}+R_{2}^{2})^{3/2}} d x = \frac{(C_0 V)^2}{4 \pi \varepsilon_0 R_1^2} \int_{-\infty}^{0} \frac{1}{t^2 + 1} \frac{R_2^2 - 2 R_1^2 t^2}{(R_1^{2}t^{2}+R_{2}^{2})^{3/2}} R_1^{3} d t\tag{6}$$

这里我们发现在绝大多数积分区域中， $\sqrt{t^{2}+(R_{2}/R_{1})^{2}}$ 已经几乎是 $\sqrt { ( R _ { 2 } / R _ { 1 } ) ^ { 2 } }$ ，所以作为近似估计:

$$W \approx \frac{(C_{0}V)^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}^{3}} R_{1}^{2} \int_{-\infty}^{0} \frac{1}{t^{2}+1} \left(R_{2}^{2}-2 R_{1}^{2} t^{2}\right) d t \approx \frac{(C_{0}V)^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}^{3}} R_{1}^{2} \int_{-\infty}^{0} \frac{1}{t^{2}+1} d t = \frac{(C_{0}V)^{2}}{8 \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}^{3}} R_{1}^{2}\tag{7}$$

这里后一步考虑到了绝大多数积分仍能保证 $R_{2}^{2}-2R_{1}^{2}t^{2} \approx R_{2}^{2}$ ，于是可以得到第一次的进入速度 $\sqrt{2W/m}$ :

$$v_{1}=\frac{C_{0}VR_{1}}{2R_{2}\sqrt{m\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}}}\tag{8}$$

②此时可以近似认为接触时存在充放电过程，那么系统的等效电路应该看成地表、球体、电极三个部分互相连接，而且通过电容C连接，此时球体——电极并联了接触电阻 $R_{0}$ ，而球体——地表之间存在恒压电源。此时球体本身带电量Q会和电极带电Q共同产生了电势:

$$\varphi_{b}=\frac{1}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{1}}(Q^{'}-\frac{QR_{1}}{R_{2}})\tag{9}$$

此时考虑到充放电关系:

$$\frac{dQ^{'}}{dt}=\frac{V}{R_{0}}=\frac{V_{0}-\varphi_{b}}{R_{0}}=\frac{V_{0}-\frac{1}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{1}}\left(Q^{'}-\frac{QR_{1}}{R_{2}}\right)}{R_{0}}=-\frac{1}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{0}R_{1}}Q^{'}+\frac{V_{0}}{R_{0}}\left(1+\frac{C_{0}}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}}\right)\tag{10}$$

这是一个简单微分方程，经过给定时间 $\varDelta / v_{0}$ 后，带电量为:

$$\begin{align*}q_{1} = 4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{1} V_{0} \left( 1 + \frac{C_{0}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}} \right) \left[ 1 - \exp \left( - \frac{1}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{0} R_{1}} \frac{\varDelta}{v_{0}} \right) \right] \\= 4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{1} V_{0} \left( 1 + \frac{C_{0}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}} \right) \left[ 1 - \exp \left( - \frac{1}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{0} R_{1}} \frac{2 R_{2} \sqrt{m\varepsilon_{0} R_{2}} \varDelta}{C_{0} V R_{1}} \right) \right] \tag{11}\end{align*}$$

③当球体获得电荷量后，此时的受力会发生变化，此时受力不只是电偶极矩部分的贡献，还有净电荷量的贡献，但要记住电偶极矩发生反向，但是电场梯度不变:

$$f = - \frac{C_{0}V}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}}\frac{C_{0}VR_{1}^{3}}{x^{2} + R_{1}^{2}}\frac{R_{2}^{2} - 2x^{2}}{(x^{2}+R_{2}^{2})^{3/2}} + q_{1}E = - \frac{C_{0}V}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}}\frac{C_{0}VR_{1}^{3}}{x^{2} + R_{1}^{2}}\frac{R_{2}^{2} - 2x^{2}}{(x^{2}+R_{2}^{2})^{3/2}} + q_{1}\frac{C_{0}V}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}}\frac{x}{\sqrt{x^{2} + R_{2}^{2}}}\tag{12}$$

还是基于类似的道理，当质点运动到x方向的正无穷时，外力所做的功将会是:

$$\begin{aligned}W = - \int_{0}^{\infty} \frac{C_{0} V}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0}} \frac{C_{0} V R_{1}^{3}}{x^{2} + R_{1}^{2}} \frac{R_{2}^{2} - 2 x^{2}}{(x^{2}+R_{2}^{2})^{3/2}} dx + & \int_{0}^{\infty} q_{1} \frac{C_{0} V}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0}} \frac{x}{\sqrt{x^{2} + R_{2}^{2}}} dx = - \frac{(C_{0} V)^{2}}{8 \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}^{3}} R_{1}^{2} + \int_{0}^{\infty} q_{1} \frac{C_{0} V}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0}} \frac{x}{\sqrt{x^{2} + R_{2}^{2}}} dx \\= & - \frac{(C_{0} V)^{2}}{8 \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}^{3}} R_{1}^{2} + \frac{C_{0} V q_{1}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}} \tag{13}\end{aligned}$$

还是同样的道理，当球体进入后，设定r为进入距离，此时由于电压降低为负数，此时会受到一个静电感应引力和点电荷受力的共同作用:

$$f = \frac{C_{0}V}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}}\frac{C_{0}VR_{1}^{3}}{x^{2} + R_{1}^{2}}\frac{R_{2}^{2} - 2x^{2}}{(x^{2}+R_{2}^{2})^{3/2}} - q_{1}\frac{C_{0}V}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}}\frac{x}{\sqrt{x^{2} + R_{2}^{2}}}\tag{14}$$

做功量为:

$$W_{r} = \int_{- \infty}^{0}f(x)dx = \frac{(C_{0}V)^{2}}{8\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}^{3}}R_{1}^{2} + \frac{C_{0}Vq_{1}}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}}\tag{15}$$

此时可以发现最后的进入速度为:

$$v_{2}=\sqrt{\frac{2}{m}(W+W_{r})}=\sqrt{\frac{2}{m}\left(\frac{(C_{0}V)^{2}}{8\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}^{3}}R_{1}^{2}+\frac{C_{0}Vq_{1}}{2\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}}\right)}=\sqrt{\frac{(C_{0}V)^{2}}{4m\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}^{3}}R_{1}^{2}+\frac{C_{0}Vq_{1}}{m\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}}}\tag{16}$$

④此时在电路中将会对应:

$$\frac{dQ^{'}} {dt} = - \frac{1}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{0}R_{1}}Q^{'} - \frac{V_{0}}{R_{0}}\left(1 + \frac{C_{0}}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}}\right)\tag{17}$$

代入初态得到:

$$q_{2} = - 4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{1} V_{0} \left( 1 + \frac{C_{0}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}} \right) + \left[ 4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{1} V_{0} \left( 1 + \frac{C_{0}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}} \right) + q_{1} \right] \exp \left( - \frac{1}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{0} R_{1}} \frac{\Delta}{\sqrt{\frac{(C_{0} V)^{2}}{4 m \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}^{3}} R_{1}^{2} + \frac{C_{0} V q_{1}}{m \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}}}} \right) \tag{18}$$

出射后受力为:

$$f = - \frac{C_{0}V}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}}\frac{C_{0}VR_{1}^{3}}{x^{2} + R_{1}^{2}}\frac{R_{2}^{2} - 2x^{2}}{(x^{2}+R_{2}^{2})^{3/2}} - q_{2}\frac{C_{0}V}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}}\frac{x}{\sqrt{x^{2} + R_{2}^{2}}}\tag{19}$$

这时候求得做功:

$$W_{r}=\int_{0}^{\infty}fdx=-\frac{\left(C_{0}V\right)^{2}}{8\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}^{3}}R_{1}^{2}-\frac{C_{0}Vq_{2}}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}}\tag{20}$$

最后一圈下来，末态的速度便是:

$$v _ { 3 } = \sqrt { - \frac { C _ { 0 } V q _ { 2 } } { 2 m \pi \varepsilon _ { 0 } R _ { 2 } } + \frac { C _ { 0 } V q _ { 1 } } { m \pi \varepsilon _ { 0 } R _ { 2 } } } \tag{21}$$

(2)考虑到 $\varDelta/v$ 非常小，此时指数可以近似化简为仅有电阻维系的充电过程，此时可以简单求出充电的电荷量增幅:

$$\varDelta q = \int - \frac{1}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{0} R_{1}} Q^{'} + \frac{V_{0}}{R_{0}} \left( 1 + \frac{C_{0}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}} \right) dt = - \frac{1}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{0} R_{1}} q_{0} \frac{\varDelta}{v} + \frac{V_{0}}{R_{0}} \left( 1 + \frac{C_{0}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}} \right) \frac{\varDelta}{v} \tag{22}$$

给定 $v_{N}$ 和电荷量 $q_{N}$ 后，利用我们先前的结论，可以得到:

①经过A的进入速度:

$$v_{N,A} = \sqrt{v_{N}^{2} + \frac{2}{m}\left(\frac{(C_{0}V)^{2}}{8\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}^{3}}R_{1}^{2} - \frac{C_{0}Vq_{N}}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}}\right)} \tag{23}$$

②经过A的电荷量:

$$q_{N,A} = q_N + \left[ \frac{V_0}{R_0} \left( 1 + \frac{C_0}{4 \pi \varepsilon_0 R_2} \right) - \frac{1}{4 \pi \varepsilon_0 R_0 R_1} q_N \right] \frac{\varDelta}{\sqrt{v_N^2 + \frac{2}{m} \left( \frac{(C_0 V)^2}{8 \varepsilon_0 R_2^3} R_1^2 - \frac{C_0 V q_N}{4 \pi \varepsilon_0 R_2} \right)}} \tag{24}$$

③远离A的速度:

$$\begin{aligned}v_{N,A}' = \sqrt{v_{N,A}^{2} + \frac{2}{m}\left( - \frac{(C_{0}V)^{2}}{8\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}^{3}}R_{1}^{2} + \frac{C_{0}Vq_{N,A}}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}} \right)} \\= \sqrt{v_{N}^{2} + \frac{C_{0}V}{2m\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}}\left[ \frac{V_{0}}{R_{0}}\left( 1 + \frac{C_{0}}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}} \right) - \frac{1}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{0}R_{1}}q_{N} \right]\frac{\Delta}{\sqrt{v_{N}^{2} + \frac{2}{m}\left( \frac{(C_{0}V)^{2}}{8\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}^{3}}R_{1}^{2} - \frac{C_{0}Vq_{N}}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}} \right)}}}\tag{25} \end{aligned}$$

④进入B的速度:

$$\begin{aligned}v_{N,B} &= \sqrt{v_{N,A}^{'2}+\frac{2}{m}\left(\frac{(C_{0} V)^{2}}{8 \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}^{3}} R_{1}^{2}+\frac{C_{0} V q_{N,A}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}}\right)}=\sqrt{v_{N,A}^{'2}+\frac{C_{0} V q_{N,A}}{m \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}}} \\&=\sqrt{v_{N}^{2}+\frac{2}{m}\left(\frac{(C_{0} V)^{2}}{8 \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}^{3}} R_{1}^{2}-\frac{C_{0} V q_{N}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}}\right)+\frac{C_{0} V q_{N,A}}{m \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}}} \tag{26}\end{aligned}$$

⑤经过B的电荷量:

$$q_{N,B} = q_{N,A} + \left[ - \frac{V_0}{R_0} \left( 1 + \frac{C_0}{4 \pi \varepsilon_0 R_2} \right) - \frac{1}{4 \pi \varepsilon_0 R_0 R_1} q_{N,A} \right] \frac{\Delta}{\sqrt{v_{N}^{2} + \frac{2}{m} \left( \frac{\left( C_0 V \right)^2}{8 \varepsilon_0 R_2^3} R_1^2 - \frac{C_0 V q_{N}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_0 R_2} \right) + \frac{C_0 V q_{N,A}}{m \pi \varepsilon_0 R_2}}} \tag{27}$$

⑥末态返回速度:

$$v_{N+1} = \sqrt{v_{N}^{2} + \frac{2}{m} \left( - \frac{(C_{0}V)^{2}}{8\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}^{3}}R_{1}^{2} + \frac{C_{0}Vq_{N,B}}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}} \right)} \tag{28}$$

此时可以发现速率平方增量为:

$$\begin{aligned}\varDelta v_{N}^{2} = \frac{2}{m} \left[ \frac{(C_{0}V)^{2}}{8\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}^{3}}R_{1}^{2} - \frac{C_{0}Vq_{N}}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}} - \frac{(C_{0}V)^{2}}{8\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}^{3}}R_{1}^{2} + \frac{C_{0}Vq_{N,A}}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}} + \frac{(C_{0}V)^{2}}{8\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}^{3}}R_{1}^{2} + \frac{C_{0}Vq_{N,A}}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}} - \frac{(C_{0}V)^{2}}{8\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}^{3}}R_{1}^{2} - \frac{C_{0}Vq_{N,B}}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}} \right] \\= \frac{C_{0}V}{2m\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}} \left[ 2q_{N,A} - q_{N} - q_{N,B} \right] \tag{29} \end{aligned}$$

实际上这个增量的计算并不复杂，因为考虑到充电时间很短，所以一周期的速度改变量理当来说很小，全都是凭借 $\frac{(C_{0}V)^{2}}{8\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}^{3}}$ 项作为一个桥梁为球体提供可观速度的。此时可认为:

$$\begin{aligned} & 2 q_{\mathrm{N}, A} - q_{\mathrm{N}} - q_{\mathrm{N}, B} = \left[ \frac{V}{R_0} \left( 1 + \frac{C_0}{4 \pi \varepsilon_0 R_2} \right) - \frac{1}{4 \pi \varepsilon_0 R_0 R_1} q_{\mathrm{N}} \right] \frac{\varDelta}{\sqrt{v_N^2 + \frac{2}{m} \left( \frac{\left( C_0 V \right)^2}{8 \varepsilon_0 R_2^3} R_1^2 - \frac{C_0 V q_{\mathrm{N}}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_0 R_2} \right)}} \\& - \left[ - \frac{V}{R_0} \left( 1 + \frac{C_0}{4 \pi \varepsilon_0 R_2} \right) - \frac{1}{4 \pi \varepsilon_0 R_0 R_1} q_{\mathrm{N}, A} \right] \frac{\varDelta}{\sqrt{v_N^2 + \frac{2}{m} \left( \frac{\left( C_0 V \right)^2}{8 \varepsilon_0 R_2^3} R_1^2 - \frac{C_0 V q_{\mathrm{N}}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_0 R_2} \right) + \frac{C_0 V q_{\mathrm{N}, A}}{m \pi \varepsilon_0 R_2}}} \tag{30} \end{aligned}$$

中，一切 $q$ 的变化量极小，而且q引起的速度改变也很小，只有静电感应吸附很重要，此时:

$$2 q _ { N , A } - q _ { N } - q _ { N , B } \approx \frac { C _ { 0 } V } { 2 m \pi \varepsilon _ { 0 } R _ { 2 } } \frac { 2 V } { R _ { 0 } } \bigg ( 1 + \frac { C _ { 0 } } { 4 \pi \varepsilon _ { 0 } R _ { 2 } } \bigg ) \frac { \varDelta } { \sqrt { v _ { N } ^ { 2 } + \displaystyle \frac { 2 } { m } \bigg ( \frac { ( C _ { 0 } V ) ^ { 2 } } { 8 \varepsilon _ { 0 } R _ { 2 } ^ { 3 } } R _ { 1 } ^ { 2 } - \frac { C _ { 0 } V q _ { N } } { 4 \pi \varepsilon _ { 0 } R _ { 2 } } \bigg ) } } \tag{31}$$

这里我们意识到如果定义 $v_{A,N}$ 计算速度会更方便，因为:

$$\Delta v_{A,N}^{2}=\frac{C_{0}V^{2}}{m\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{0}R_{2}}\left(1+\frac{C_{0}}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}}\right)\frac{\Delta}{v_{A,N}}\tag{32}$$

此时关于它关于N的增量，直接计算:

$$\sum v_{A,N}\varDelta v_{A,N}^{2}=N\frac{C_{0}V^{2}}{m\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{0}R_{2}}\left(1+\frac{C_{0}}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}}\right)\varDelta \approx \int_{\frac{C_{0}VR_{1}}{2R_{2}\sqrt{m\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}}}}^{v}2v_{A,N}^{2}dv_{A,N}=\frac{2}{3}\left[v^{3}-\left(\frac{C_{0}VR_{1}}{2R_{2}\sqrt{m\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}}}\right)^{3}\right]\tag{34}$$

得到:

$$v _ { A , N } = \left[ \frac { C _ { 0 } V R _ { 1 } } { 2 R _ { 2 } \sqrt { m \varepsilon _ { 0 } R _ { 2 } } } + N \frac { 3 C _ { 0 } V ^ { 2 } } { 2 m \pi \varepsilon _ { 0 } R _ { 0 } R _ { 2 } } \left( 1 + \frac { C _ { 0 } } { 4 \pi \varepsilon _ { 0 } R _ { 2 } } \right) \right] ^ { 1 / 3 } \tag{35}$$



(1)①设x为环心和球心距离，由于球体本身不带电，此时为了保证球体静电平衡，电极上的电荷必然对此产生感应电荷。考虑到电极细，可视作线电荷分布，设 $Q = C_{0}V$ 其带电量，此时可以求出球体的镜像电荷:

$$Q^{'} = - \frac{C_{0}VR_{1}}{\sqrt{x^{2} + R_{1}^{2}}}\tag{1}$$

此时中心存在补充电荷:

$$Q_{c}=-Q^{'}=\frac{C_{0}VR_{1}}{\sqrt{x^{2}+R_{1}^{2}}}\tag{2}$$

此时考虑到电极距离足够远，两种组电荷可以近似构成沿着x方向的电偶极矩:

$$p = - Q \times \frac{R_{1}^{2}}{\sqrt{x^{2} + R_{1}^{2}}} = + \frac{C_{0}VR_{1}^{3}}{x^{2} + R_{1}^{2}}\tag{3}$$

此时考虑到外部电场为:

$$E(x) = \frac{C_{0}V}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}}\frac{x}{\sqrt{x^{2} + R_{2}^{2}}}\tag{4}$$

此时得到电偶极矩受力为:

$$f = p \frac{dE}{dx} = \frac{C_{0}V}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0}} \frac{C_{0}VR_{1}^{3}}{x^{2} + R_{1}^{2}} \left[ \frac{1}{\sqrt{x^{2} + R_{2}^{2}}} - \frac{3}{2} \frac{2x^{2}}{(x^{2}+R_{2}^{2})^{3/2}} \right] = \frac{C_{0}V}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0}} \frac{C_{0}VR_{1}^{3}}{x^{2} + R_{1}^{2}} \frac{R_{2}^{2} - 2x^{2}}{(x^{2}+R_{2}^{2})^{3/2}}\tag{5}$$

因此得到从球体滚来到接触时，外力所做的功:

$$W = \int_{-\infty}^{0} f d x = \frac{(C_0 V)^2 R_1^2}{4 \pi \varepsilon_0} \int_{-\infty}^{0} \frac{1}{x^2 + R_1^2} \frac{R_2^2 - 2 x^2}{(x^{2}+R_{2}^{2})^{3/2}} d x = \frac{(C_0 V)^2}{4 \pi \varepsilon_0 R_1^2} \int_{-\infty}^{0} \frac{1}{t^2 + 1} \frac{R_2^2 - 2 R_1^2 t^2}{(R_1^{2}t^{2}+R_{2}^{2})^{3/2}} R_1^{3} d t\tag{6}$$

这里我们发现在绝大多数积分区域中， $\sqrt{t^{2}+(R_{2}/R_{1})^{2}}$ 已经几乎是 $\sqrt { ( R _ { 2 } / R _ { 1 } ) ^ { 2 } }$ ，所以作为近似估计:

$$W \approx \frac{(C_{0}V)^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}^{3}} R_{1}^{2} \int_{-\infty}^{0} \frac{1}{t^{2}+1} \left(R_{2}^{2}-2 R_{1}^{2} t^{2}\right) d t \approx \frac{(C_{0}V)^{2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}^{3}} R_{1}^{2} \int_{-\infty}^{0} \frac{1}{t^{2}+1} d t = \frac{(C_{0}V)^{2}}{8 \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}^{3}} R_{1}^{2}\tag{7}$$

这里后一步考虑到了绝大多数积分仍能保证 $R_{2}^{2}-2R_{1}^{2}t^{2} \approx R_{2}^{2}$ ，于是可以得到第一次的进入速度 $\sqrt{2W/m}$ :

$$v_{1}=\frac{C_{0}VR_{1}}{2R_{2}\sqrt{m\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}}}\tag{8}$$

②此时可以近似认为接触时存在充放电过程，那么系统的等效电路应该看成地表、球体、电极三个部分互相连接，而且通过电容C连接，此时球体——电极并联了接触电阻 $R_{0}$ ，而球体——地表之间存在恒压电源。此时球体本身带电量Q会和电极带电Q共同产生了电势:

$$\varphi_{b}=\frac{1}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{1}}(Q^{'}-\frac{QR_{1}}{R_{2}})\tag{9}$$

此时考虑到充放电关系:

$$\frac{dQ^{'}}{dt}=\frac{V}{R_{0}}=\frac{V_{0}-\varphi_{b}}{R_{0}}=\frac{V_{0}-\frac{1}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{1}}\left(Q^{'}-\frac{QR_{1}}{R_{2}}\right)}{R_{0}}=-\frac{1}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{0}R_{1}}Q^{'}+\frac{V_{0}}{R_{0}}\left(1+\frac{C_{0}}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}}\right)\tag{10}$$

这是一个简单微分方程，经过给定时间 $\varDelta / v_{0}$ 后，带电量为:

$$\begin{align*}q_{1} = 4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{1} V_{0} \left( 1 + \frac{C_{0}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}} \right) \left[ 1 - \exp \left( - \frac{1}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{0} R_{1}} \frac{\varDelta}{v_{0}} \right) \right] \\= 4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{1} V_{0} \left( 1 + \frac{C_{0}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}} \right) \left[ 1 - \exp \left( - \frac{1}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{0} R_{1}} \frac{2 R_{2} \sqrt{m\varepsilon_{0} R_{2}} \varDelta}{C_{0} V R_{1}} \right) \right] \tag{11}\end{align*}$$

③当球体获得电荷量后，此时的受力会发生变化，此时受力不只是电偶极矩部分的贡献，还有净电荷量的贡献，但要记住电偶极矩发生反向，但是电场梯度不变:

$$f = - \frac{C_{0}V}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}}\frac{C_{0}VR_{1}^{3}}{x^{2} + R_{1}^{2}}\frac{R_{2}^{2} - 2x^{2}}{(x^{2}+R_{2}^{2})^{3/2}} + q_{1}E = - \frac{C_{0}V}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}}\frac{C_{0}VR_{1}^{3}}{x^{2} + R_{1}^{2}}\frac{R_{2}^{2} - 2x^{2}}{(x^{2}+R_{2}^{2})^{3/2}} + q_{1}\frac{C_{0}V}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}}\frac{x}{\sqrt{x^{2} + R_{2}^{2}}}\tag{12}$$

还是基于类似的道理，当质点运动到x方向的正无穷时，外力所做的功将会是:

$$\begin{aligned}W = - \int_{0}^{\infty} \frac{C_{0} V}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0}} \frac{C_{0} V R_{1}^{3}}{x^{2} + R_{1}^{2}} \frac{R_{2}^{2} - 2 x^{2}}{(x^{2}+R_{2}^{2})^{3/2}} dx + & \int_{0}^{\infty} q_{1} \frac{C_{0} V}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0}} \frac{x}{\sqrt{x^{2} + R_{2}^{2}}} dx = - \frac{(C_{0} V)^{2}}{8 \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}^{3}} R_{1}^{2} + \int_{0}^{\infty} q_{1} \frac{C_{0} V}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0}} \frac{x}{\sqrt{x^{2} + R_{2}^{2}}} dx \\= & - \frac{(C_{0} V)^{2}}{8 \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}^{3}} R_{1}^{2} + \frac{C_{0} V q_{1}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}} \tag{13}\end{aligned}$$

还是同样的道理，当球体进入后，设定r为进入距离，此时由于电压降低为负数，此时会受到一个静电感应引力和点电荷受力的共同作用:

$$f = \frac{C_{0}V}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}}\frac{C_{0}VR_{1}^{3}}{x^{2} + R_{1}^{2}}\frac{R_{2}^{2} - 2x^{2}}{(x^{2}+R_{2}^{2})^{3/2}} - q_{1}\frac{C_{0}V}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}}\frac{x}{\sqrt{x^{2} + R_{2}^{2}}}\tag{14}$$

做功量为:

$$W_{r} = \int_{- \infty}^{0}f(x)dx = \frac{(C_{0}V)^{2}}{8\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}^{3}}R_{1}^{2} + \frac{C_{0}Vq_{1}}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}}\tag{15}$$

此时可以发现最后的进入速度为:

$$v_{2}=\sqrt{\frac{2}{m}(W+W_{r})}=\sqrt{\frac{2}{m}\left(\frac{(C_{0}V)^{2}}{8\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}^{3}}R_{1}^{2}+\frac{C_{0}Vq_{1}}{2\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}}\right)}=\sqrt{\frac{(C_{0}V)^{2}}{4m\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}^{3}}R_{1}^{2}+\frac{C_{0}Vq_{1}}{m\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}}}\tag{16}$$

④此时在电路中将会对应:

$$\frac{dQ^{'}} {dt} = - \frac{1}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{0}R_{1}}Q^{'} - \frac{V_{0}}{R_{0}}\left(1 + \frac{C_{0}}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}}\right)\tag{17}$$

代入初态得到:

$$q_{2} = - 4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{1} V_{0} \left( 1 + \frac{C_{0}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}} \right) + \left[ 4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{1} V_{0} \left( 1 + \frac{C_{0}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}} \right) + q_{1} \right] \exp \left( - \frac{1}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{0} R_{1}} \frac{\Delta}{\sqrt{\frac{(C_{0} V)^{2}}{4 m \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}^{3}} R_{1}^{2} + \frac{C_{0} V q_{1}}{m \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}}}} \right) \tag{18}$$

出射后受力为:

$$f = - \frac{C_{0}V}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}}\frac{C_{0}VR_{1}^{3}}{x^{2} + R_{1}^{2}}\frac{R_{2}^{2} - 2x^{2}}{(x^{2}+R_{2}^{2})^{3/2}} - q_{2}\frac{C_{0}V}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}}\frac{x}{\sqrt{x^{2} + R_{2}^{2}}}\tag{19}$$

这时候求得做功:

$$W_{r}=\int_{0}^{\infty}fdx=-\frac{\left(C_{0}V\right)^{2}}{8\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}^{3}}R_{1}^{2}-\frac{C_{0}Vq_{2}}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}}\tag{20}$$

最后一圈下来，末态的速度便是:

$$v _ { 3 } = \sqrt { - \frac { C _ { 0 } V q _ { 2 } } { 2 m \pi \varepsilon _ { 0 } R _ { 2 } } + \frac { C _ { 0 } V q _ { 1 } } { m \pi \varepsilon _ { 0 } R _ { 2 } } } \tag{21}$$

(2)考虑到 $\varDelta/v$ 非常小，此时指数可以近似化简为仅有电阻维系的充电过程，此时可以简单求出充电的电荷量增幅:

$$\varDelta q = \int - \frac{1}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{0} R_{1}} Q^{'} + \frac{V_{0}}{R_{0}} \left( 1 + \frac{C_{0}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}} \right) dt = - \frac{1}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{0} R_{1}} q_{0} \frac{\varDelta}{v} + \frac{V_{0}}{R_{0}} \left( 1 + \frac{C_{0}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}} \right) \frac{\varDelta}{v} \tag{22}$$

给定 $v_{N}$ 和电荷量 $q_{N}$ 后，利用我们先前的结论，可以得到:

①经过A的进入速度:

$$v_{N,A} = \sqrt{v_{N}^{2} + \frac{2}{m}\left(\frac{(C_{0}V)^{2}}{8\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}^{3}}R_{1}^{2} - \frac{C_{0}Vq_{N}}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}}\right)} \tag{23}$$

②经过A的电荷量:

$$q_{N,A} = q_N + \left[ \frac{V_0}{R_0} \left( 1 + \frac{C_0}{4 \pi \varepsilon_0 R_2} \right) - \frac{1}{4 \pi \varepsilon_0 R_0 R_1} q_N \right] \frac{\varDelta}{\sqrt{v_N^2 + \frac{2}{m} \left( \frac{(C_0 V)^2}{8 \varepsilon_0 R_2^3} R_1^2 - \frac{C_0 V q_N}{4 \pi \varepsilon_0 R_2} \right)}} \tag{24}$$

③远离A的速度:

$$\begin{aligned}v_{N,A}' = \sqrt{v_{N,A}^{2} + \frac{2}{m}\left( - \frac{(C_{0}V)^{2}}{8\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}^{3}}R_{1}^{2} + \frac{C_{0}Vq_{N,A}}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}} \right)} \\= \sqrt{v_{N}^{2} + \frac{C_{0}V}{2m\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}}\left[ \frac{V_{0}}{R_{0}}\left( 1 + \frac{C_{0}}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}} \right) - \frac{1}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{0}R_{1}}q_{N} \right]\frac{\Delta}{\sqrt{v_{N}^{2} + \frac{2}{m}\left( \frac{(C_{0}V)^{2}}{8\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}^{3}}R_{1}^{2} - \frac{C_{0}Vq_{N}}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}} \right)}}}\tag{25} \end{aligned}$$

④进入B的速度:

$$\begin{aligned}v_{N,B} &= \sqrt{v_{N,A}^{'2}+\frac{2}{m}\left(\frac{(C_{0} V)^{2}}{8 \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}^{3}} R_{1}^{2}+\frac{C_{0} V q_{N,A}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}}\right)}=\sqrt{v_{N,A}^{'2}+\frac{C_{0} V q_{N,A}}{m \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}}} \\&=\sqrt{v_{N}^{2}+\frac{2}{m}\left(\frac{(C_{0} V)^{2}}{8 \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}^{3}} R_{1}^{2}-\frac{C_{0} V q_{N}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}}\right)+\frac{C_{0} V q_{N,A}}{m \pi \varepsilon_{0} R_{2}}} \tag{26}\end{aligned}$$

⑤经过B的电荷量:

$$q_{N,B} = q_{N,A} + \left[ - \frac{V_0}{R_0} \left( 1 + \frac{C_0}{4 \pi \varepsilon_0 R_2} \right) - \frac{1}{4 \pi \varepsilon_0 R_0 R_1} q_{N,A} \right] \frac{\Delta}{\sqrt{v_{N}^{2} + \frac{2}{m} \left( \frac{\left( C_0 V \right)^2}{8 \varepsilon_0 R_2^3} R_1^2 - \frac{C_0 V q_{N}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_0 R_2} \right) + \frac{C_0 V q_{N,A}}{m \pi \varepsilon_0 R_2}}} \tag{27}$$

⑥末态返回速度:

$$v_{N+1} = \sqrt{v_{N}^{2} + \frac{2}{m} \left( - \frac{(C_{0}V)^{2}}{8\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}^{3}}R_{1}^{2} + \frac{C_{0}Vq_{N,B}}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}} \right)} \tag{28}$$

此时可以发现速率平方增量为:

$$\begin{aligned}\varDelta v_{N}^{2} = \frac{2}{m} \left[ \frac{(C_{0}V)^{2}}{8\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}^{3}}R_{1}^{2} - \frac{C_{0}Vq_{N}}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}} - \frac{(C_{0}V)^{2}}{8\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}^{3}}R_{1}^{2} + \frac{C_{0}Vq_{N,A}}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}} + \frac{(C_{0}V)^{2}}{8\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}^{3}}R_{1}^{2} + \frac{C_{0}Vq_{N,A}}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}} - \frac{(C_{0}V)^{2}}{8\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}^{3}}R_{1}^{2} - \frac{C_{0}Vq_{N,B}}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}} \right] \\= \frac{C_{0}V}{2m\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}} \left[ 2q_{N,A} - q_{N} - q_{N,B} \right] \tag{29} \end{aligned}$$

实际上这个增量的计算并不复杂，因为考虑到充电时间很短，所以一周期的速度改变量理当来说很小，全都是凭借 $\frac{(C_{0}V)^{2}}{8\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}^{3}}$ 项作为一个桥梁为球体提供可观速度的。此时可认为:

$$\begin{aligned} & 2 q_{\mathrm{N}, A} - q_{\mathrm{N}} - q_{\mathrm{N}, B} = \left[ \frac{V}{R_0} \left( 1 + \frac{C_0}{4 \pi \varepsilon_0 R_2} \right) - \frac{1}{4 \pi \varepsilon_0 R_0 R_1} q_{\mathrm{N}} \right] \frac{\varDelta}{\sqrt{v_N^2 + \frac{2}{m} \left( \frac{\left( C_0 V \right)^2}{8 \varepsilon_0 R_2^3} R_1^2 - \frac{C_0 V q_{\mathrm{N}}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_0 R_2} \right)}} \\& - \left[ - \frac{V}{R_0} \left( 1 + \frac{C_0}{4 \pi \varepsilon_0 R_2} \right) - \frac{1}{4 \pi \varepsilon_0 R_0 R_1} q_{\mathrm{N}, A} \right] \frac{\varDelta}{\sqrt{v_N^2 + \frac{2}{m} \left( \frac{\left( C_0 V \right)^2}{8 \varepsilon_0 R_2^3} R_1^2 - \frac{C_0 V q_{\mathrm{N}}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_0 R_2} \right) + \frac{C_0 V q_{\mathrm{N}, A}}{m \pi \varepsilon_0 R_2}}} \tag{30} \end{aligned}$$

中，一切 $q$ 的变化量极小，而且q引起的速度改变也很小，只有静电感应吸附很重要，此时:

$$2 q _ { N , A } - q _ { N } - q _ { N , B } \approx \frac { C _ { 0 } V } { 2 m \pi \varepsilon _ { 0 } R _ { 2 } } \frac { 2 V } { R _ { 0 } } \bigg ( 1 + \frac { C _ { 0 } } { 4 \pi \varepsilon _ { 0 } R _ { 2 } } \bigg ) \frac { \varDelta } { \sqrt { v _ { N } ^ { 2 } + \displaystyle \frac { 2 } { m } \bigg ( \frac { ( C _ { 0 } V ) ^ { 2 } } { 8 \varepsilon _ { 0 } R _ { 2 } ^ { 3 } } R _ { 1 } ^ { 2 } - \frac { C _ { 0 } V q _ { N } } { 4 \pi \varepsilon _ { 0 } R _ { 2 } } \bigg ) } } \tag{31}$$

这里我们意识到如果定义 $v_{A,N}$ 计算速度会更方便，因为:

$$\Delta v_{A,N}^{2}=\frac{C_{0}V^{2}}{m\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{0}R_{2}}\left(1+\frac{C_{0}}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}}\right)\frac{\Delta}{v_{A,N}}\tag{32}$$

此时关于它关于N的增量，直接计算:

$$\sum v_{A,N}\varDelta v_{A,N}^{2}=N\frac{C_{0}V^{2}}{m\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{0}R_{2}}\left(1+\frac{C_{0}}{4\pi\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}}\right)\varDelta \approx \int_{\frac{C_{0}VR_{1}}{2R_{2}\sqrt{m\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}}}}^{v}2v_{A,N}^{2}dv_{A,N}=\frac{2}{3}\left[v^{3}-\left(\frac{C_{0}VR_{1}}{2R_{2}\sqrt{m\varepsilon_{0}R_{2}}}\right)^{3}\right]\tag{34}$$

得到:

$$v _ { A , N } = \left[ \frac { C _ { 0 } V R _ { 1 } } { 2 R _ { 2 } \sqrt { m \varepsilon _ { 0 } R _ { 2 } } } + N \frac { 3 C _ { 0 } V ^ { 2 } } { 2 m \pi \varepsilon _ { 0 } R _ { 0 } R _ { 2 } } \left( 1 + \frac { C _ { 0 } } { 4 \pi \varepsilon _ { 0 } R _ { 2 } } \right) \right] ^ { 1 / 3 } \tag{35}$$

五、（55分）参考解答:

(1)由于傍轴近似成立，所以可以考虑一个轴向坐标 $z \sim z + dz$ ，半径为r的柱面，此时通过柱面的热流由能量守恒确定，此时若 $r < \chi ,$ 考虑到 $r < \chi$ 区域集中了所有光能，那么有:
questions.analysis:
$$j \times 2 \pi r d x = d P ( r ) \tag{1}$$

其中 $P(r)$ 是输入功率，它是激光所提供的:

$$d P ( r ) = I ( x ) \times \pi r ^ { 2 } - I ( x + d x ) \times \pi r ^ { 2 } \tag{2}$$

考虑到光强衰减和光能沿着光线传播的事实:

$$J(x) = \frac{\chi^{2}(0)}{\chi^{2}(x)} I_{0}(x) \tag{3}$$

其中 $I_{0}(r)$ 是x处均匀方向传播的光强:

$$\frac{dI_{0}(x)}{ds}=-\mu I_{0}(x)\tag{4}$$

其中s是传播距离，在旁轴近似下:

$$s \approx x . I _ { 0 } ( x ) = I _ { 0 } e ^ { - \mu x } \tag{5}$$

此时得到:

$$I(x) = \frac{\chi^{2}(0)}{\chi^{2}(x)} I_{0} e^{-\mu x} \tag{6}$$

那么根据能量守恒，自然得到了:

$$d P ( r ) = \mu \pi r ^ { 2 } \frac { \chi ^ { 2 } ( 0 ) } { \chi ^ { 2 } ( x ) } I _ { 0 } e ^ { - \mu x } d x \tag{7}$$

因此得到了热流:

$$j = \frac{dP}{2\pi rdx} = \frac{1}{2} \mu r \frac{\chi^2(0)}{\chi^2(x)} I_0 e^{-\mu x} \tag{8}$$

显然，如果半径大于 $\chi$ 的话，此时对应:

$$j = \frac{1}{2} \mu \frac{\chi^{2}(x)}{r} \frac{\chi^{2}(0)}{\chi^{2}(x)} I_{0} e^{-\mu x} = \frac{1}{2} \mu \frac{\chi^{2}(0)}{r} I_{0} e^{-\mu x} \tag{9}$$

接下来计算温度分布，考虑到傅里叶热传导定律:

$$\lambda_{m}=\frac{b}{T_{s}}=2.90nm\tag{1}$$

可见热辐射光子能量很高，此时光子能量增益系数为:

$$\eta = \frac{E_{0}}{hc / \lambda_{m}} = \frac{100 \times 10^{3}}{\frac{6.63 \times 10^{-31} \times 3 \times 10^{8}}{1.6 \times 10^{-19} \times 2.90 \times 10^{-9}}} = 233\tag{2}$$

因此热辐射光子的逆康普顿散射是非常重要的。

(2)在电子本征系中，光子的能量可以通过四维变换求出:

$$E_{L.c} = \frac{E_{L} + \beta E_{L} \cos \theta}{\sqrt{1 - \beta^{2}}}\tag{3}$$

在该参考系中电子会经过一次弹性康普顿散射。设 $\phi$ 为末态散射光子和光子入射方向夹角，设 $E_{L}^{'}$ 为末态光子能量，可以根据动量守恒求出电子动量大小:

$$p_{c} = \frac{1}{c} \sqrt{E_{L.e}^{2} + E_{L}^{'2} - 2E_{L.e}E_{L}^{'} \cos \phi}\tag{4}$$

根据能量守恒:

$$\begin{aligned} &E_{L,c} + m_e c^2 = \sqrt{(m_e c^2)^2 + (p_e c)^2} + E_L^{'} \Longrightarrow (m_e c^2)^2 + (p_e c)^2 \\ = &\left(E_{L,c} - E_L^{'}\right)^2 + (m_e c^2)^2 + 2m_e c^2 (E_{L,c} - E_L^{'}) = (m_e c^2)^2 + E_{L,c}^2 + E_L^{'2} - 2E_{L,c} E_L^{'} \cos \phi \end{aligned}\tag{5}$$

这里可以得到方程:

$$2m_{e}c^{2}(E_{L,c}-E_{L}^{'})=E_{L,c}^{2}+E_{L}^{'2}-2E_{L,c}E_{L}^{'}\cos\phi-(E_{L,c}-E_{L}^{'})^{2}=2E_{L,c}E_{L}^{'}(1-\cos\phi)\tag{6}$$

得到末态光子能量满足:

$$\frac{1}{E_{L}^{'}} - \frac{1}{E_{L.c}} = \frac{1 - \cos \phi}{m_{e} c^{2}}\tag{7}$$

得到了散射光子能量:

$$E_{L}^{'}=\frac{E_{L.c}}{1+\frac{1-\cos\phi}{m_{e}c^{2}}E_{L.c}}\tag{8}$$

最后研究散射光子的能量，将电子本征系结果变换至黑洞参考系。沿着电子本征系的光子轴建立球坐标，设 $\phi$ 为末态散射方向和初态夹角，$\psi$ 为散射方位在垂直于初态方向平面投影和反应平面一侧的夹角，规定末态变换速度 $\psi = 0$。接下来找出变换速度的方向，根据初态速度变换可以得到光子和入射电子的夹角补角 $\theta^{'}$:

$$\cos \theta^{'} = \frac{c_{r}}{c} = \frac{\cos \theta + \beta}{1 + \cos \theta \times \beta}\tag{9}$$

可以发现电子变换黑洞系的方向为:

$$\hat{n} = \left( \sin \theta^{'} , 0 , \cos \theta^{'} \right)\tag{10}$$

根据多普勒变换公式，给定末态散射方位:

$$\hat{u}_{L} = ( \sin \theta \cos \psi , \sin \theta \sin \psi , \cos \theta )\tag{11}$$

根据多普勒变换公式，得到黑洞参考系的末态光子能量:

$$E_{L.s} = \frac{E_{L}^{'} - \beta \hat{n} \cdot \hat{n}_{L}E_{L}^{'}}{\sqrt{1 - \beta^{2}}} = \frac{E_{L}^{'}}{1 + \frac{1 - \cos\phi}{m_{e}c^{2}}E_{L.s}} \frac{1 - \beta(\cos\theta\cos\phi + \sin\theta\sin\phi\cos\psi)}{\sqrt{1 - \beta^{2}}}\tag{12}$$

接下来我们代入所有参数，得到完整的能量公式:

$$\begin{aligned} E_{L,s} &= \frac{1}{1 - \beta^{2}}\frac{E_{L} + \beta E_{L}\cos\theta}{1 + \frac{1 - \cos\phi}{m_{e}c^{2}}\frac{E_{L} + \beta E_{L}\cos\theta}{\sqrt{1 - \beta^{2}}}}\left[ 1 - \beta\left( \frac{\cos\theta + \beta}{1 + \beta\cos\theta}\cos\phi + \frac{\sqrt{1 - \beta^{2}}\sin\theta}{1 + \beta\cos\theta}\sin\phi\cos\psi \right) \right]\\ &= \frac{E_{L}E_{e}^{2}}{\left( m_{e}c^{2} \right)^{2}}\frac{1 + \beta\cos\theta}{1 + \frac{E_{L}E_{e}}{\left( m_{e}c^{2} \right)^{2}}(1 + \beta\cos\theta)(1 - \cos\phi)}\left[ 1 - \beta\left( \frac{\cos\theta + \beta}{1 + \beta\cos\theta}\cos\phi + \frac{\sqrt{1 - \beta^{2}}\sin\theta}{1 + \beta\cos\theta}\sin\phi\cos\psi \right) \right]\end{aligned}\tag{13}$$

考虑到表达式中角度变换可以考虑近似，将变换角取1:

$$\begin{aligned} E \cong & \frac{E_{L}E_{e}^{2}}{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}} \frac{1}{1+\frac{E_{L}E_{e}}{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}}(1+\beta\cos\theta)(1-\cos\phi)}\bigg[1+\beta\cos\theta-\beta\left((1+\beta\cos\theta)\cos\phi+\sqrt{1-\beta^{2}}\sin\theta\sin\phi\cos\psi\right)\bigg] \\ & =\frac{E_{L}E_{e}}{m_{e}c^{2}} \frac{1}{1+\frac{E_{L}E_{e}}{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}}(1+\beta\cos\theta)(1-\cos\phi)}\bigg[(1+\beta\cos\theta)(1-\beta\cos\phi)-\beta\frac{m_{e}c^{2}}{E_{e}}\sin\theta\sin\phi\cos\psi\bigg]\end{aligned}\tag{14}$$

高能极限下，考虑到 $\theta$ 的限制，若选取 $\phi=\pi/2$，定是能量极大值:

$$\begin{aligned} &\frac{E_{L}E_{e}^{2}}{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}}\frac{1}{1+\frac{E_{L}E_{e}}{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}}(1+\beta\cos\theta)(1-\cos\phi)}\left[(1+\beta\cos\theta)(1-\beta\cos\phi)-\beta\frac{m_{e}c^{2}}{E_{e}}\sin\theta\sin\phi\cos\psi\right]\\&\Rightarrow\frac{E_{L}E_{e}^{2}}{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}}\frac{(1+\beta\cos\theta)(1-\cos\phi)}{1+\frac{E_{L}E_{e}}{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}}(1+\beta\cos\theta)(1-\cos\phi)}\Rightarrow E_{\max}=\frac{E_{L}E_{e}^{2}}{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}}\frac{(1+\beta\cos\theta)}{1+\frac{E_{L}E_{e}}{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}}(1+\beta\cos\theta)}\end{aligned}\tag{15}$$

对于低能极限:

$$\begin{aligned}\phi = 0, &\frac{E_{L}E_{e}^{2}}{\left( m_{e}c^{2} \right)^{2}} \frac{1 + \beta \cos \theta}{1 + \frac{E_{L}E_{e}}{\left( m_{e}c^{2} \right)^{2}}(1 + \beta \cos \theta)(1 - \cos \phi)} \Bigg[ 1 - \beta \left( \frac{\cos \theta + \beta}{1 + \beta \cos \theta} \cos \phi + \frac{\sqrt{1 - \beta^{2}} \sin \theta}{1 + \beta \cos \theta} \sin \phi \cos \psi \right) \Bigg] \\= & \frac{E_{L}E_{e}^{2}}{\left( m_{e}c^{2} \right)^{2}}(1 - \beta^{2}) = E_{L} \end{aligned}\tag{16}$$

由此可以看出从头到尾，光子总是可以获得能量；

②注意到本征系中散射是球对称的，关于 $\phi,\psi$ 作平均可以得到一级结果:

$$\frac{E_{L}E_{e}^{2}}{\left(m_{e}c^{2}\right)^{2}}\frac{1+\beta\cos\theta}{1+\frac{E_{L}E_{e}}{\left(m_{e}c^{2}\right)^{2}}(1+\beta\cos\theta)(1-\cos\phi)}\left[1-\beta\frac{\cos\theta+\beta}{1+\beta\cos\theta}\cos\phi\right]\tag{17}$$

可以庆幸的是这个平均可以严格计算，考虑:

$$\begin{aligned}\frac{E_{L}E_{e}^{2}}{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}} & \frac{1+\beta\cos\theta}{1+\frac{E_{L}E_{e}}{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}}(1+\beta\cos\theta)(1-\cos\phi)}\left[1-\beta\frac{\cos\theta+\beta}{1+\beta\cos\theta}\cos\phi\right] \\= & \frac{E_{L}E_{e}^{2}}{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}}\times\frac{1}{2}\int_{-1}^{1}d\cos\phi\times\frac{1+\beta\cos\theta}{1+\frac{E_{L}E_{e}}{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}}(1+\beta\cos\theta)(1-\cos\phi)}\left[1-\beta\frac{\cos\theta+\beta}{1+\beta\cos\theta}\cos\phi\right] \\& = \frac{E_{e}}{2}\int_{-1}^{1}\frac{dx}{\frac{E_{L}E_{e}}{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}}(1+\beta\cos\theta)+1-x}\left[1-\beta\frac{\cos\theta+\beta}{1+\beta\cos\theta}x\right] \\= & \beta\frac{\cos\theta+\beta}{1+\beta\cos\theta}E_{e}+\frac{E_{e}}{2}\left[1-\beta\frac{\cos\theta+\beta}{1+\beta\cos\theta}\left(\frac{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}}{E_{L}E_{e}(1+\beta\cos\theta)}+1\right)\right]\ln\left[\frac{2E_{L}E_{e}(1+\beta\cos\theta)}{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}}+1\right]\end{aligned}\tag{18}$$

接下来我们考虑低能近似和修正、如果能量很低、考虑一级修正:

$$\begin{aligned}\overline{E} = & \beta \frac{\cos \theta + \beta}{1 + \beta \cos \theta} E_e + \frac{E_e}{2} \left[ 1 - \beta \frac{\cos \theta + \beta}{1 + \beta \cos \theta} \left( \frac{(m_e c^2)^2}{E_L E_e (1 + \beta \cos \theta)} + 1 \right) \right] \ln \left[ \frac{2 E_L E_e (1 + \beta \cos \theta)}{(m_e c^2)^2} + 1 \right] \\\approx & \beta \frac{\cos \theta + \beta}{1 + \beta \cos \theta} E_e + \frac{E_e}{2} \left[ 1 - \beta \frac{\cos \theta + \beta}{1 + \beta \cos \theta} \left( \frac{(m_e c^2)^2}{E_L E_e (1 + \beta \cos \theta)} + 1 \right) \right] \frac{2 E_L E_e (1 + \beta \cos \theta)}{(m_e c^2)^2} \\= & \frac{E_e}{2} \left[ 1 - \beta \frac{\cos \theta + \beta}{1 + \beta \cos \theta} \right] \frac{2 E_L E_e (1 + \beta \cos \theta)}{(m_e c^2)^2} = \frac{E_L E_e^2}{(m_e c^2)^2} (1 - \beta^2) = E_L \end{aligned}\tag{19}$$

这里给出了最低光子能量，因此考虑二级修正可以给出能量增幅:

$$\begin{aligned}\Delta E = & \frac{E_{e}}{2}\Bigg[1 - \beta\frac{\cos\theta + \beta}{1 + \beta\cos\theta}\Bigg(\frac{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}}{E_{L}E_{e}(1 + \beta\cos\theta)} + 1\Bigg)\Bigg] \times \frac{1}{2}\Bigg(\frac{2E_{L}E_{e}(1 + \beta\cos\theta)}{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}}\Bigg)^{2} \\= & \frac{E_{e}}{2} \cdot \frac{\cos\theta + \beta}{1 + \beta\cos\theta}\Bigg(\frac{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}}{E_{L}E_{e}(1 + \beta\cos\theta)} + 1\Bigg)\frac{1}{2}\Bigg(\frac{2E_{L}E_{e}(1 + \beta\cos\theta)}{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}}\Bigg)^{2} - \frac{E_{e}}{2}\Bigg(\frac{2E_{L}E_{e}(1 + \beta\cos\theta)}{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}}\Bigg)^{2} \\\approx & E_{e} \beta\frac{\cos\theta + \beta}{1 + \beta\cos\theta}\frac{E_{L}E_{e}(1 + \beta\cos\theta)}{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}} = \beta(\cos\theta + \beta)\frac{E_{e}^{2}}{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}}E_{L} \end{aligned}\tag{20}$$

(3)①直接计算平均能量:

$$E = \gamma m_{e} c^{2} = \int_{0}^{\infty} \frac{c^{3}}{2(k_{B}T)^{3}} p^{2} \exp\left(-\frac{pc}{k_{B}T}\right) pc\, dp = 3k_{B}T\tag{21}$$

因此

$$T_{e}=\frac{\bar{\gamma}m_{e}c^{2}}{3k_{B}}=5.93\times10^{10}K\tag{22}$$

这是一个非常惊人的温度；

$\kappa$ 代表了传播过程的光子被介质吸收——(2分)；$S$ 代表了传播过程中介质激发光子——(1分)；$\lambda$ 代表了光子被介质散射、其频率发生变化——(3分)；

虽然单次散射可以给光子提供可观的能量，但是其平均下来的能量并不会那么大。利用(20)可求出平均光子能量增幅:

$$\overline{\Delta E} = \beta^{2} \frac{E_{e}^{2}}{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}} E_{L} \approx \gamma^{2} E_{L}\tag{23}$$

利用统计分布计算平均增幅:

$$\overline{\Delta E} = E_{L} \times \int \frac{c^{3}}{2(k_{B}T)^{3}}p^{2}\exp\left(-\frac{pc}{k_{B}T}\right)dp \times \frac{p^{2}}{(m_{e}c)^{2}} = E_{L} \times 12\left(\frac{k_{B}T}{m_{e}c^{2}}\right)^{2} = \frac{1}{3}\gamma^{2}E_{L}\tag{24}$$

不考虑多次散射、这是出于一次散射光子能量远超平均值而作下的论断，考虑给定移动距离 $dl$，此时被散射的光子数为:

$$d N = N_{L} \times n_{e} \sigma dx = - d N_{L} \Longrightarrow N_{L} = N_{L,0} e^{-n_{e}\sigma l}\tag{25}$$

因此平均上来说，平均能量为:

$$\begin{aligned}\overline{E} \approx & \frac{N_{L,0}e^{-n_e\sigma l} \times \frac{4}{3}\gamma^2 E_{L,0} + N_{L,0}(1-e^{-n_e\sigma l})E_{L,0}}{N_{L,0}} \approx E_{L,0} \times \left[\frac{4}{3}\gamma^2 e^{-n_e\sigma l} + 1\right], \eta = \frac{4}{3}\gamma^2 e^{-n_e\sigma l} + 1\end{aligned}\tag{26}$$

黑洞电子面密度可以利用 $n_e l$ 计算，因为光子几乎运动了一个黑洞晕的厚度，此时:

$$\sigma_{e}=n_{e}l=\frac{1}{\sigma}\ln\frac{\frac{1}{3}\gamma^{2}}{\eta-1}=\frac{1}{\pi r_{e}^{2}}\ln\frac{\frac{1}{3}\gamma^{2}}{\eta-1}=6.62\times10^{28}m^{-2}\tag{27}$$

②首先注意到回旋运动角频率决定了受力角频率，进而得到本征系加速度变化频率。根据动力学方程:

$$\frac{d\vec{p}}{dt}=-e\vec{v}\times\vec{B}=\frac{e\vec{B}}{\gamma m_{e}}\times\vec{p}\Longrightarrow\omega=\frac{eB}{\gamma m_{e}}\tag{28}$$

根据钟效应，本征时更小、因此本征系有效频率更大:

$$\omega_{c}=\omega\times\frac{dt}{d\tau}=\frac{eB}{m_{e}}\tag{29}$$

这决定了本征系光频率，此时考虑到绝大多数光子应该沿着电子方向出射，此时根据多普勒效应公式:

$$\omega_{o}=\omega_{c}\sqrt{\frac{1+\beta}{1-\beta}}\approx2\gamma^{2}\frac{eB}{m_{e}}\tag{30}$$

主要波长即可给定:

$$\lambda_{c}=\frac{2\pi c}{2\gamma^{2}\frac{eB}{m_{e}}}=\frac{\pi m_{e}c}{eB\gamma^{2}}\tag{31}$$

②代入数值:

$$\lambda_{c}=0.059\mathrm{~nm}\tag{32}$$

这个波长太大、几乎没有增益贡献。——(2分)

由此可以看出从头到尾，光子总是可以获得能量；

②注意到本征系中散射是球对称的，关于 $\phi,\psi$ 作平均可以得到一级结果:

$$\frac{E_{L}E_{e}^{2}}{\left(m_{e}c^{2}\right)^{2}}\frac{1+\beta\cos\theta}{1+\frac{E_{L}E_{e}}{\left(m_{e}c^{2}\right)^{2}}(1+\beta\cos\theta)(1-\cos\phi)}\left[1-\beta\frac{\cos\theta+\beta}{1+\beta\cos\theta}\cos\phi\right]\tag{17}$$

可以庆幸的是这个平均可以严格计算，考虑:

$$\begin{aligned}\frac{E_{L}E_{e}^{2}}{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}} & \frac{1+\beta\cos\theta}{1+\frac{E_{L}E_{e}}{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}}(1+\beta\cos\theta)(1-\cos\phi)}\left[1-\beta\frac{\cos\theta+\beta}{1+\beta\cos\theta}\cos\phi\right] \\= & \frac{E_{L}E_{e}^{2}}{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}}\times\frac{1}{2}\int_{-1}^{1}d\cos\phi\times\frac{1+\beta\cos\theta}{1+\frac{E_{L}E_{e}}{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}}(1+\beta\cos\theta)(1-\cos\phi)}\left[1-\beta\frac{\cos\theta+\beta}{1+\beta\cos\theta}\cos\phi\right] \\& = \frac{E_{e}}{2}\int_{-1}^{1}\frac{dx}{\frac{E_{L}E_{e}}{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}}(1+\beta\cos\theta)+1-x}\left[1-\beta\frac{\cos\theta+\beta}{1+\beta\cos\theta}x\right] \\= & \beta\frac{\cos\theta+\beta}{1+\beta\cos\theta}E_{e}+\frac{E_{e}}{2}\left[1-\beta\frac{\cos\theta+\beta}{1+\beta\cos\theta}\left(\frac{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}}{E_{L}E_{e}(1+\beta\cos\theta)}+1\right)\right]\ln\left[\frac{2E_{L}E_{e}(1+\beta\cos\theta)}{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}}+1\right]\end{aligned}\tag{18}$$

接下来我们考虑低能近似和修正、如果能量很低、考虑一级修正:

$$\begin{aligned}\overline{E} = & \beta \frac{\cos \theta + \beta}{1 + \beta \cos \theta} E_e + \frac{E_e}{2} \left[ 1 - \beta \frac{\cos \theta + \beta}{1 + \beta \cos \theta} \left( \frac{(m_e c^2)^2}{E_L E_e (1 + \beta \cos \theta)} + 1 \right) \right] \ln \left[ \frac{2 E_L E_e (1 + \beta \cos \theta)}{(m_e c^2)^2} + 1 \right] \\\approx & \beta \frac{\cos \theta + \beta}{1 + \beta \cos \theta} E_e + \frac{E_e}{2} \left[ 1 - \beta \frac{\cos \theta + \beta}{1 + \beta \cos \theta} \left( \frac{(m_e c^2)^2}{E_L E_e (1 + \beta \cos \theta)} + 1 \right) \right] \frac{2 E_L E_e (1 + \beta \cos \theta)}{(m_e c^2)^2} \\= & \frac{E_e}{2} \left[ 1 - \beta \frac{\cos \theta + \beta}{1 + \beta \cos \theta} \right] \frac{2 E_L E_e (1 + \beta \cos \theta)}{(m_e c^2)^2} = \frac{E_L E_e^2}{(m_e c^2)^2} (1 - \beta^2) = E_L \end{aligned}\tag{19}$$

这里给出了最低光子能量，因此考虑二级修正可以给出能量增幅:

$$\begin{aligned}\Delta E = & \frac{E_{e}}{2}\Bigg[1 - \beta\frac{\cos\theta + \beta}{1 + \beta\cos\theta}\Bigg(\frac{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}}{E_{L}E_{e}(1 + \beta\cos\theta)} + 1\Bigg)\Bigg] \times \frac{1}{2}\Bigg(\frac{2E_{L}E_{e}(1 + \beta\cos\theta)}{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}}\Bigg)^{2} \\= & \frac{E_{e}}{2} \cdot \frac{\cos\theta + \beta}{1 + \beta\cos\theta}\Bigg(\frac{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}}{E_{L}E_{e}(1 + \beta\cos\theta)} + 1\Bigg)\frac{1}{2}\Bigg(\frac{2E_{L}E_{e}(1 + \beta\cos\theta)}{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}}\Bigg)^{2} - \frac{E_{e}}{2}\Bigg(\frac{2E_{L}E_{e}(1 + \beta\cos\theta)}{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}}\Bigg)^{2} \\\approx & E_{e} \beta\frac{\cos\theta + \beta}{1 + \beta\cos\theta}\frac{E_{L}E_{e}(1 + \beta\cos\theta)}{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}} = \beta(\cos\theta + \beta)\frac{E_{e}^{2}}{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}}E_{L} \end{aligned}\tag{20}$$

(3)①直接计算平均能量:

$$E = \gamma m_{e} c^{2} = \int_{0}^{\infty} \frac{c^{3}}{2(k_{B}T)^{3}} p^{2} \exp\left(-\frac{pc}{k_{B}T}\right) pc\, dp = 3k_{B}T\tag{21}$$

因此

$$T_{e}=\frac{\bar{\gamma}m_{e}c^{2}}{3k_{B}}=5.93\times10^{10}K\tag{22}$$

这是一个非常惊人的温度；

$\kappa$ 代表了传播过程的光子被介质吸收——(2分)；$S$ 代表了传播过程中介质激发光子——(1分)；$\lambda$ 代表了光子被介质散射、其频率发生变化——(3分)；

虽然单次散射可以给光子提供可观的能量，但是其平均下来的能量并不会那么大。利用(20)可求出平均光子能量增幅:

$$\overline{\Delta E} = \beta^{2} \frac{E_{e}^{2}}{(m_{e}c^{2})^{2}} E_{L} \approx \gamma^{2} E_{L}\tag{23}$$

利用统计分布计算平均增幅:

$$\overline{\Delta E} = E_{L} \times \int \frac{c^{3}}{2(k_{B}T)^{3}}p^{2}\exp\left(-\frac{pc}{k_{B}T}\right)dp \times \frac{p^{2}}{(m_{e}c)^{2}} = E_{L} \times 12\left(\frac{k_{B}T}{m_{e}c^{2}}\right)^{2} = \frac{1}{3}\gamma^{2}E_{L}\tag{24}$$

不考虑多次散射、这是出于一次散射光子能量远超平均值而作下的论断，考虑给定移动距离 $dl$，此时被散射的光子数为:

$$d N = N_{L} \times n_{e} \sigma dx = - d N_{L} \Longrightarrow N_{L} = N_{L,0} e^{-n_{e}\sigma l}\tag{25}$$

因此平均上来说，平均能量为:

$$\begin{aligned}\overline{E} \approx & \frac{N_{L,0}e^{-n_e\sigma l} \times \frac{4}{3}\gamma^2 E_{L,0} + N_{L,0}(1-e^{-n_e\sigma l})E_{L,0}}{N_{L,0}} \approx E_{L,0} \times \left[\frac{4}{3}\gamma^2 e^{-n_e\sigma l} + 1\right], \eta = \frac{4}{3}\gamma^2 e^{-n_e\sigma l} + 1\end{aligned}\tag{26}$$

黑洞电子面密度可以利用 $n_e l$ 计算，因为光子几乎运动了一个黑洞晕的厚度，此时:

$$\sigma_{e}=n_{e}l=\frac{1}{\sigma}\ln\frac{\frac{1}{3}\gamma^{2}}{\eta-1}=\frac{1}{\pi r_{e}^{2}}\ln\frac{\frac{1}{3}\gamma^{2}}{\eta-1}=6.62\times10^{28}m^{-2}\tag{27}$$

②首先注意到回旋运动角频率决定了受力角频率，进而得到本征系加速度变化频率。根据动力学方程:

$$\frac{d\vec{p}}{dt}=-e\vec{v}\times\vec{B}=\frac{e\vec{B}}{\gamma m_{e}}\times\vec{p}\Longrightarrow\omega=\frac{eB}{\gamma m_{e}}\tag{28}$$

根据钟效应，本征时更小、因此本征系有效频率更大:

$$\omega_{c}=\omega\times\frac{dt}{d\tau}=\frac{eB}{m_{e}}\tag{29}$$

这决定了本征系光频率，此时考虑到绝大多数光子应该沿着电子方向出射，此时根据多普勒效应公式:

$$\omega_{o}=\omega_{c}\sqrt{\frac{1+\beta}{1-\beta}}\approx2\gamma^{2}\frac{eB}{m_{e}}\tag{30}$$

主要波长即可给定:

$$\lambda_{c}=\frac{2\pi c}{2\gamma^{2}\frac{eB}{m_{e}}}=\frac{\pi m_{e}c}{eB\gamma^{2}}\tag{31}$$

②代入数值:

$$\lambda_{c}=0.059\mathrm{~nm}\tag{32}$$

这个波长太大、几乎没有增益贡献。——(2分)
